newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down on economic concerns.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down on economic concerns.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished down on Thursday amid mixed sentiment about an economic reforms package to be announced by the government on Friday, dealers said.
"The market is a bit jittery ahead of the package," an analyst at a foreign brokerage house said, adding that investors were not ready to hold on to their positions.

The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index fell 13.95 points, or 0.86 percent, to end at 1,613.38. Losers led gainers 136 to 132. Turnover fell to 50 million shares from 56 million on Wednesday.

Bank of Punjab fell 0.35 to 30 rupees but Adamjee Insurance rose 1.0 to 111. D.G. Khan Cement fell 1.15 to 16.50, Hub Power Co 0.35 to 38.40 and Pakistan State Oil 4.0 to 285. PTCL fell 0.70 to 30.55, ICI Pakistan 0.75 to 25.15 and FFC Jordan Fertiliser 0.40 to 18.25. Engro Chemicals rose 3.0 to 185.
